title:
Why new launches
*won't get cheaper*
source: source: URA land sales · developer launch prices
caption:
You are a developer. You just paid $1,400 psf for land. You can't sell cheap. 🏗️

Rule of thumb: launch price is about 2.2 times land price. Sky at Holland and Vela Bay both followed it.

As a buyer, would you buy now or wait? Comment NOW or WAIT 👇

lines.say: Sky at Holland. Land at twelve eighty five. Launched near twenty nine hundred.
lines.cap: Sky at Holland. land *$1,285*. launched near *$2,900*

lines.say: Vela Bay. Land at thirteen eighty eight. Launched near twenty eight eighty six.
So land at fourteen to fifteen hundred today points to launches near three thousand psf later.
